text:
maria (Infra): kicking off bring-up for gpu-ae1. main asks: Terraform modules parity with existing pulumi stacks, remote state + locking, CI pipeline wiring, and a short validation runbook. aiming for minimal blast radius, staged capacity (2 -> 8 gpus), cost gating. pinging @devon @kai for module owners

devon: got it. i can convert the pulumi cluster module to a terraform one but need the exact resource mapping for node pool autoscaling and taints. any differences vs eu-west setup?

maria (Infra): taints + nodeSelector same as eu-west but will need stricter mgmt network ACLs (customer req). also want encrypted state in s3 with DynamoDB lock table and KMS key dedicated to region.

kai: on the pulumi side i can export state to json for import into tfstate if we decide to migrate. but we should consider leaving pulumi for control-plane and using tf for infra if that reduces churn. only thing: pulumi stack references some secrets in Pulumi Cloud which we'd need to map to Parameter Store / Secrets Manager for CI.

olivia (Platform): +1 for s3 + dynamo + KMS. CI has templates for `terraform init -backend-config` and we can reuse workspace isolation per env. i'll add a pipeline job we can toggle. also propose a policy: any new region must have cost-guard tag and quota guard that denies scaling past pre-approved units.

maria (Infra): perfect. high-level plan: 1) create s3 bucket + dynamodb lock (ops-prep), 2) create KMS key and IAM roles, 3) publish tf modules in registry, 4) CI wiring in cloud-cicd, 5) staged apply with smoke tests, 6) handoff doc to regional ops.

devon: copy of backend snippet for reviewers:

```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "redwood-terraform-state-gpu-ae1"
    key    = "infrastructure/gpu/cluster.tfstate"
    region = "us-east-1"
    encrypt = true
    dynamodb_table = "redwood-tf-locks-gpu-ae1"
  }
}
```

kai: pulumi export/import note: run `pulumi stack export --file stack.json` then you can parse state for resource ids. but beware: provider-specific metdata doesn't always translate. for nodes, we should import into terraform with `terraform import` per resource id.

ana: quick Q: who will provision the initial VPC peerings? networking has some quota limits in ae1 and we need to request additional ephemeral IP ranges.

maria (Infra): @ana we'll own peering ticket but need network team signoff. add a pre-flight checklist item: confirm IP range availability and route table limits, also check cross-region egress cost estimate.

olivia (Platform): CI job checklist (draft):
- `terraform fmt`
- `terraform validate`
- plan with `-out` and upload plan artifact
- policy check (rego) for cost tags and instance types
- manual approval gate for production

devon: cost gating: suggestion to use sentinel-like policy in pipeline to block >X vCPUs or >$Y/month estimates. for now set conservative default: max 8 A100s.

maria (Infra): validation runbook (short):
1) apply infra in staging with 2 gpus
2) run smoke workload: 1k tokens across 10 concurrent sessions to validate latency and kv cache behaviour
3) run health checks: kube node conditions, GPU driver presence, nvidia-smi output, pod eviction thresholds
4) verify autoscaler respects min/max and taints
5) run cost telemetry for 24h and ensure alert if spend > 120% of estimate

kai: i'll add commands for smoke tests. example: `kubectl -n inference run -i --rm perf-test --image=redwood/perf:latest --command -- /bin/sh -c "./run_load.sh --model small --concurrency 10 --tokens 1000"`

devon: also include terraform import examples for nodes: `terraform import module.node_pool.aws_eks_node_group.this <nodegroup-id>`

maria (Infra): handoff checklist to regional ops:
- state bucket name & KMS key id
- terraform registry module version pinned
- CI pipeline link and env vars (AWS creds, KMS alias)
- runbook link for scaling and incident playbook
- cost dashboard link and alert slugs

ana: timeline?

maria (Infra): proposal: ops-prep + iam + ksm key by Thu EOD, tf module + CI jobs by Mon next week, staged apply Tue, validation Wed, production scale Fri (if all green). adjust if network signoff delayed.

sre-bot: Incident note: if GPU driver fails on >20% nodes within 1h, auto-roll to previous image and create incident P1.

olivia (Platform): i'll create the pipeline PR and link it here when ready. tagging `#security` for KMS policy review.

devon: i'll start converting pulumi cluster bits and push a draft module to `registry/infrastructure-gpu` with `v0.1.0-alpha`. will include examples and import hints.

maria (Infra): thanks all. action items: @devon module draft, @olivia CI job, @ana networking ticket, @kai pulumi export plan. i'll own s3/kms/iam prep. will update here with resource names once created. :thumbsup:

olivia (Platform): noted, will watch for PRs.

maria (Infra): updated resource names: `redwood-terraform-state-gpu-ae1`, `redwood-tf-locks-gpu-ae1`, KMS alias `alias/redwood-gpu-ae1`. added to ops tracker.

devon: started PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/terraform-modules/pulls/42

maria (Infra): closing the planning thread. will reopen if network/quotas block us. cheers! :party_parrot:
